title: Stabilizing the buried interface via inorganic–organic hybrid layers for high-performance perovskite photovoltaics
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01195K, Paper
Yulin Xie, Ziwei Zheng, Huazhong Liu, Lin Li, Kai Gao, Xiong Li
Inverted PSCs offer durability & silicon tandem compatibility, but suffer from aggregation, poor wetting & fragility. We developed a hybrid contact using silica nanoparticles to achieve 27.35% efficiency and >1000 h stability at 65 °C, enabling scalable, robust commercialization.
